title: Cluster
description: An instrument panel: dials on the sides, tell-tales between them, digital displays below; its hud, theme, brightness and unit_system apply to every widget it holds (CLU-001 .. CLU-003, DIS-001, HUD-001 .. HUD-006, UNIT-004).

items.description: The trait dictionary of a widget, with its _kind; traits not given take the defaults of the contract.

value.description: The widgets of the cluster, each as its trait dictionary with its _kind (section 7); an item the contract rejects is shown invalid in its place (HOST-004).

unit_system.description: Applied to every widget held, except in the unit a widget sets for itself (UNIT-003, UNIT-004).

brightness.description: Brightness of every widget held, 1: full (CLU-002, HUD-006).

max_items.description: Most widgets shown; null: eight (DIS-001). The others are named as not shown.

size.description: [width, height] of the panel, in CSS pixels; each widget keeps its own size.
